basic_info.description: Tucked behind a private gated entry at the crossroads of Hayes Valley, Duboce Triangle, and the Lower Haight, this beautifully updated 2-bedroom, 2.5-bath townhouse offers a rare combination of space, serenity, and style in one of San Francisco's most vibrant neighborhoods. This 3-level home opens to a light-filled living area with 9-foot ceilings, new luxury vinyl tile flooring, and a cozy gas fireplace. The kitchen has been thoughtfully remodeled with quartz countertops and stainless steel appliances, while a formal dining area and convenient powder room make entertaining effortless. Upstairs, 2 spacious bedrooms and updated baths offer comfort and privacy, while the attached 2-car side-by-side garage includes laundry and generous storage. Outside your front door, the best of the city unfolds. With a Walk Score of 99 and Transit Score of 100, you're moments from the cultural richness of the Jazz Center, Symphony, and Opera; the trendy boutiques and restaurants of Hayes Valley; the greenery of Duboce Park; the nightlife of the Lower Haight; and the welcoming charm of the Castro. Cyclists will love direct access to the Wiggle bike route. This isn't just a condo, it's a true urban sanctuary that lives more like a house, offering a balance of city energy and personal retreat.
